name: B10-0543/2025 (ECR) – Escalation of the war and the humanitarian catastrophe in Sudan
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the escalation of the war and the humanitarian catastrophe in Sudan
part_text:
The European Parliament calls for an immediate and lasting ceasefire in Sudan, where war has caused one of the worst humanitarian crises of the century. It condemns violations by both warring sides and asks all countries to stop sending weapons and money to them. It wants safe, unhindered aid access, protection for Christians and their churches, and independent investigations so those responsible face consequences. It also asks the European Union to keep and possibly expand sanctions and to keep funding humanitarian aid.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament is stating demands and opinions, not passing law.
- **Who it affects:** Sudan's warring sides, civilians, aid groups, and countries supplying arms.
- **What happens next:** The resolution is sent to the EU Council, Commission, UN, African Union and others for follow-up.
